content.value: A voltage has a true value of 1.50 volt. An analog indicating instrument with a scale range of 0 – 2.50 volt shows a voltage of 1.46 volt. What are the values of absolute error and correction? Express the error as a function of true value and full scale deflection.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
